nodes.description: Base contract providing checked arithmetic helpers safeAdd, safeSub, safeMul, safeDiv.
Address of the current owner; set in Owned constructor from msg.sender and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, initialized to ORT.
Public token name string.
Public token decimals, set to 18.
Total token supply state variable, read by totalSupply().
Mapping of token balances by address; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount used by approve, transferFrom, allowance and approveAndCall.
Checked addition returning c = a + b with require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction requiring b <= a before computing c = a - b.
Checked multiplication with overflow guard require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Checked division requiring b > 0.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged access.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner into newOwner.
Requires msg.sender == newOwner, then moves newOwner into owner and zeroes newOwner.
Deploy-time constructor that sets metadata, mints total supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance to move tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then makes an external call to spender.receiveApproval, enabling reentrancy.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that performs an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract transferring tokens to owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balances and allowances.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed inside approveAndCall with state already written.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-supplied contract address.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply, not guarded by SafeMath.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter tokens of transfer, the amount moved between balances.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall, used as the external call target.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token, used as the external callee address.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token, the amount forwarded to the external token.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to the privileged owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before granting ownership.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall forwards msg.sender into an external receiveApproval call after writing allowance.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance reduction.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
totalSupply performs _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] without SafeMath guarding, risking underflow.
approveAndCall invokes the external receiveApproval operation after mutating the allowed mapping.
The callee contract regains control during receiveApproval and can re-enter approveAndCall/transferFrom.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external ERC20 transfer call to an arbitrary address.
Malicious token contract can re-enter the owner-only withdrawal path through the external callback.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner check protecting transferOwnership.
onlyOwner restricts transferAnyERC20Token to the stored owner.
newOwner is the required caller identity for acceptOwnership.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] inside an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before making the external call.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
Owned constructor initializes the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership transfers ownership by writing the owner state variable.
Constructor sets the _totalSupply state variable.
Constructor mints the whole supply into the balances mapping.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor initializes the name state variable.
Constructor initializes the decimals state variable.
Parameter _newOwner flows into the newOwner state variable under the onlyOwner guard.
Parameter tokens of transfer determines the amount debited and credited.
Parameter spender becomes the callee of the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter tokenAddress becomes the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token is forwarded to the external token transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Non-core parameter _newOwner has no independent semantics; it only carries the value written into newOwner by the transferOwnership function.
Non-core parameter tokens is only the amount consumed by the transfer function's safeSub/safeAdd logic, so it can be folded into that core function.
Non-core parameter spender solely determines the target of the external call unsafe operation and should be merged into it.
Non-core parameter tokenAddress only supplies the callee address of the external ERC20 transfer unsafe operation.
Non-core parameter tokens is only the amount passed through the owner-gated transferAnyERC20Token function into the external call.
